blocks.text: MANILA, Philippinrd — The Philippines has formed a technical working group to review existing and prospective free trade agreements (FTAs) and their implications for agriculture, a contentious issue in trade negotiations. Under Special Order No. 1270, the Department of Agriculture (DA) created a group to ensure that FTAs and other bilateral and multilateral agreements consider the country’s agri-food and fisheries interests. READ: Agri concerns stall PH trade talks with EU, Chile The technical working group will actively draft proposed FTAs and other agreements, and they will participate in interagency meetings on potential trade pacts, according to the DA.
